projects.name: Flamme Rouge
projects.text: A cycling site you scroll like a stage race: a procedural race bike the camera orbits part by part, six legends, and Alpe d'Huez drawn as you climb.

projects.name: Skyline Capital
projects.text: A browser 3D tycoon. Start with a food cart in a generated city, trade on a simulated stock market, take your company public and climb a world rich list.

projects.name: Online Orders API
projects.text: An API for taking and tracking online orders. Just getting started.

projects.name: This site
projects.text: The page you're on: a 400 m track in three.js, one lap per scroll, with my running inside it.
